# Young Mariners Initiative

## Charting Courses for Youth Success on the Blue Horizon

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/f41a7ddb-30a5-4167-90e1-2b020cb73727/IMG_0603.jpeg)

The Young Mariners Initiative (YMI) provides scholarships and free programming to ensure youth and adolescents in the Puget Sound region, especially those in underserved communities, have access to maritime experiences.

[Apply for a YMI Scholarship](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1xs904BYaogfEuxWNvx9AR_5C7DGXn8WEM1GaEaM7OnE/)

## Programs of The Young Mariners Initiative

### Summer Camp Scholarships
Financial assistance for CWB summer camps. See our [2026 Summer Camp offerings](https://www.cwb.org/summer-camps) and [apply for a summer camp scholarship here!](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1xs904BYaogfEuxWNvx9AR_5C7DGXn8WEM1GaEaM7OnE/)

### Afterschool Learning to Sail Program
Free for families of students facing financial barriers or from underrepresented groups.
- Ages: 8–11
- Days: Tuesday & Thursday
- Time: 4:00–6:30pm
- Capacity: 8
- Boats: El Toro
- Dates: Coming Soon

Register here!

### Sea Potential Partnership Programming
More information coming soon.

### YMI Afterschool High School Programs (Intro to Maritime)
Free for high school students facing financial barriers or from underrepresented groups. Covers STEM, woodworking, knots, and time on the water. 2026 info coming soon.

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/5c1bc0c3-eb07-4631-8b35-a2613a145f2f/IMG_4317.jpg)

### Internships at The Center
Hands-on work on the water and in the shop for high school-aged youth. Partners include:
- [Teens in Public Service Summer Internship](https://teensinpublicservice.org)
- [Gibson Ek High School](https://gibsonek.isd411.org/our-school/internships-mentorships)
- [Evergreen Goodwill Youth Maritime Program](https://evergreengoodwill.org/job-training-and-education/youth-programs/youth-maritime)
- [Port of Seattle Youth Internship Program](https://www.portseattle.org/programs/high-school-internships)
- [Youth Maritime Career Launch Internship Program](https://urbanleague.org/youth-maritime-program/)

### Intro to Maritime Careers Field Trip
For middle and high school students. Students build a model boat and sail it at Lake Union Park.
- Cost: Varies
- Available year-round, Tuesday–Friday, 9am–4pm
- 1 chaperone per 10 students required

### Junior Instructor Program
A volunteer role supporting summer camp sailors; hours can count as community service. At age 16, participants can become certified as a [US Sailing Level One Instructor](https://www.ussailing.org/education/instructor/small-boat-instructor-programs/level-1-instructor/). [Learn more about our Junior Instructor Program](https://www.cwb.org/junior-instructor)

### Boatwright in Residence Apprenticeship Program
For recent wooden boatbuilding graduates. Apprentices work across our boatshops, including the 1,000 sq ft Bill Garden Boatshop (opened 2018). The 2026 application is open. Inquiries: hiring@cwb.org

### SUPPORT YOUNG MARINERS INITATIVE SCHOLARSHIPS
To support youth scholarships, pay more than the suggested price when registering for a youth program, or [email development@cwb.org](mailto:development@cwb.org).

Other youth opportunities: [School year programs](https://www.cwb.org/youth-school-year-sailing) · [become a junior instructor](https://www.cwb.org/junior-instructor) · [Field trips](https://www.cwb.org/fieldtrips)
